evidence_quotes.O: I tested the power saving features using my Kill-a-Watt. Under no load, this switch was pulling .01 Amps (less than 1 watt).
evidence_quotes.C: I will post this same review in the other new models, so the comparisons will be more comprehensive than if I were to individualize more.
evidence_quotes.E: I have used it (the Dell) every day at work for 3 years now and I LOVE it.
evidence_quotes.A: saying that it can't change lenses or that it is big and clunky is not fair.
evidence_quotes.N: I found it to be ever so slightly off-level, so don't put too much trust in it--just use it as a guideline
